target: monitor/analyst/attention-inbox.json writer (decider) vs reader (analyst.md Mode 2b dispatcher)
summary: Decider runs 2026-06-07 wrote attention-inbox items ATTN-001/002/003 with a divergent schema (resolved:boolean, subject/detail fields, ATTN-NNN ids) instead of the canonical status:"pending" schema. The analyst Mode 2b dispatcher filters x.status==="pending", so all three items were INVISIBLE to the dispatcher — Mode 2b reported NO ATTENTION ITEMS while 2 unresolved verification requests (ATTN-002 medium, ATTN-003 high) sat in the file. Caught by Mode 6 fresh-eyes pass 2026-06-08; both items verified and resolved this run.
detail: Three sub-findings: (1) WRITER DRIFT — decider-2026-06-07T13-24/17-11/21-30 used {id:ATTN-NNN, resolved:false, subject, detail/details} where the canonical shape per analyst.md Mode 2b and prior archive lines is {id:ATT-<ts>-N, status:"pending", reason}. Field name even varies within the batch (ATTN-001 "details", ATTN-002/003 "detail"). (2) READER MISS — analyst.md Mode 2b check is status-based only; it should defensively also treat resolved===false as pending, or the decider writer should be normalized. (3) HYGIENE — ATTN-001 was resolved:true by decider but left in the live file; PROP-022 phase 4 requires resolved items be appended to attention-inbox-archive.jsonl and removed from live. All three items have now been archived+removed by analyst (this run). RESOLUTION CONTENT NOTE: ATTN-002 note text itself cited a dead DOI (10.1007/s00190-002-0237-3, handle-not-found) as the thing to verify, but the actually-integrated WIN-011 text carries the correct Yang & Wang 2002 DOI 10.1023/A:1021119023985 (Crossref-verified). No live-surface defect; the dead string existed only in the note. Recommend: patch decider attention-inbox-writer step to emit canonical schema + archive-on-resolve, and optionally harden analyst.md Mode 2b filter to (x.status==="pending"||x.resolved===false). Route prompt edits via tinker if preferred.

evidence.verification_outcomes: ATTN-002: integrated DOI correct; ATTN-003: (a) Mansinha DOI resolves, (b) correction notices read naturally, (c) dead DOI only in index.html.baseline
